title: Parallel Diffusion Solver via Residual Dirichlet Policy Optimization
tldr_zh: 每步并行评估 K 个学得中点梯度做单纯形加权，蒸馏+Dirichlet 残差策略 RL；5 NFE CIFAR-10 FID 4.33
